item.title: Alessia Cara Grew Up with Us: How Her Sound Has Matured
item.description: Grammy winner Alessia Cara began her music career at just 13, when she was signed by Def Jam Recordings. Her young start meant that she’s grown up with her Gen Z listeners— and her music, too, has matured. Her former pop anthems have matured into hearty, pop and r&b, with jazz and blues undertones, especially in her new album, “Love & Hyperbole”.Cara’s original sound was angsty, honest, part of an “anti party” movement in pop.
